summary: Trio Petroleum Corp filed Amendment No. 10 to its prospectus supplement, updating an at-the-market (ATM) equity issuance program. The registrant acts as issuer, increasing the aggregate offering under its existing ATM agreement with Ladenburg Thalmann from $24,208,000 to up to $65,000,000 of common stock, with shares previously sold totaling $24,207,305. This is a routine capital-raising update triggered by the company's public float exceeding $75 million, removing certain sales limitations under Form S-3. No premium, board recommendation, or special-situation mechanics are involved. The filing constitutes an ordinary shelf takedown update with no event-driven special situation.
